attributes.action: Record for Compulsory 24/7 Public Sector Recording.
attributes.additional_details:
Protects the Public Provides an objective, indisputable record of events when a patient or citizen raises concerns Protects Frontline Staff Safeguards workers against false allegations, verbal abuse, or unwarranted disciplinary actions. Ensures Fairness Removes the "their word against mine" dynamic, bringing clarity & speed to formal investigations. 
By establishing clear guidelines & limiting access to formal complaint investigations, we can build a safer, more transparent environment.
attributes.background: We all at Healthcare Whistle-Blowers Support Group want  mandatory 24/7 audio & video recording for all public sector staff while on duty excluding break times. Audio recording to be prioritized during sensitive interactions to preserve dignity,video would be used in standard operational settings

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you mean by “all public sector staff” as well as the specific interactions you would like to be recorded during staff work hours.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do, which public sector staff you would like the proposal to be targeted at, and the “clear guidelines” you are calling for.
